evals.prompt: give me a quick health check on my robinhood portfolio. whats the single biggest risk and the one thing i should change first
evals.expected_output: Multi-account snapshot with masked accounts, combined concentration (NVDA ~36%), options book incl. collateral and early-assignment risk, one prioritized action
assertions: Covers all three accounts (Individual, Roth, MCP) in the snapshot
Masks account numbers (no full 9-digit account number appears)
Reports combined NVDA weight across accounts (roughly 35-38%)
Notes that short-put collateral ties up cash (buying power far below cash)
Flags early-assignment risk or near-zero extrinsic on the deep-ITM PLTR $50 call
Names one single biggest risk and one prioritized first action
Opens with a bottom line answering the question within the first ~6 lines
Answer is 800 words or fewer
No order/review/write tool was called

evals.prompt: i want to collect some premium over the next few weeks without getting wrecked by earnings. which of my positions should i write covered calls on, what strike and expiry? dont place anything
evals.expected_output: Earnings-aware covered call pick(s) with expiry before earnings, delta ~0.15-0.25, <=50% coverage, Roth-first location, management rules, no orders placed
assertions: Recommended expiry falls before that underlying's next earnings date
Recommended strike delta is within roughly 0.15-0.30
EVERY suggested call (including optional/add-on ones) keeps per-lot coverage at or below 50%
Explicitly treats lots under 200 free shares as ineligible for covered calls
Recommends the Roth IRA as the account for the calls (tax-free)
Excludes or defers names reporting within the window (e.g. MSFT, AMZN, HOOD)
Gives a take-profit price/rule
Did not pull the full get_earnings_calendar (used targeted earnings lookups)
Fetched at most 4 candidate strikes per underlying via get_option_instruments
Answer is 800 words or fewer
No order/review/write tool was called
